settings.locale: not set by the test; its checks compare numbers, not text

dates.posted: every transaction is made at to-date-t64 and posted on that day, 2024-03-15 10:59 UTC (5.17:bindings/guile/test/test-engine-extras.scm:118-142)

book: Three groups in one book, one per test function, each with its own environment and its own top-level "Root" (ASSET) with Asset.Bank, Asset.Wallet and Expenses (EXPENSE), USD (:14-19); the accounts are listed above by group and full name. one-tx-in: Bank +$100 from Expenses (:41). one-tx-skip: Bank +$100 from Wallet (:84). both-way: Bank +$100 from Expenses, then Expenses +$50 from Bank (:117-118).
calcSelection: The test never renders the Cash Flow report. It calls cash-flow-calc-money-in-out (5.17:gnucash/report/reports/cash-flow-calc.scm:33-106) with the settings of each run's "calc", identity conversions (to-report-currency and exchange-fn return the amount unchanged, :26-28) and include-trading-accounts off, and reads the result alist. A check's "read" names the item: money-in-alist or money-out-alist ("expected" lists the accounts in it, [] for none); money-in-collector or money-out-collector, summed in USD with gnc:sum-collector-commodity; or, with "account", that account's collector in the named alist, summed the same way. "expected" is then the exact amount the test compares with equal?, as a decimal string. "implied" marks what the test needs without asserting it: (cadr (assoc account alist)) raises an error when the account is missing.
reportEquivalent: Each run's "report" is the Cash Flow (template Cash Flow, GUID f8748b813fab4220ba26e743aedf38da) red-ale checks in place of the calculation: the run's accounts, Start Date and End Date 2024-03-15 (the report widens them to the start and end of the day, and nothing is posted on 2024-03-14), every other option at its default (full names on, USD, pricedb-nearest). Its rows are worked from 5.17:gnucash/report/reports/standard/cash-flow.scm:266-317, not read from GnuCash output: each "in" or "out" row is an account's full name and amount under "Money into selected accounts comes from" or "Money out of selected accounts goes to", then the Money In, Money Out and Difference totals.
